### SEVERITY: HIGH — Off-by-one error in `last_n` slice
> util.py:15: return items[len(items) - n - 1:]

The slice calculation is incorrect. For a list of length 5 with n=2, the formula yields `items[2:]` which returns 3 items instead of 2. The correct formula should be `items[len(items) - n:]` or simply `items[-n:]` to return the last n items.

### SEVERITY: MEDIUM — Division by zero in `mean`
> util.py:19: return sum(xs) / len(xs)

The function will crash with `ZeroDivisionError` if called with an empty list. The function lacks input validation to handle the edge case of an empty sequence.

VERDICT: FAIL
